name: kinetic-rubberband-toggle
title: Kinetic Rubberband Toggle
description: A switch control whose pill thumb elongates and squashes during travel, simulating high-elasticity rubber before snapping into rest shape.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Click Drag Snap Toggle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
